verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so giving a coding agent a persistent runtime with automatic checkpoints is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence does not show this capability. The agent-facing features are short-lived instances for one-off commands and per-PR preview environments, both ephemeral. The automatic daily disk snapshots are mentioned only for backing a ClickHouse service's disk, which is an adjacent backup feature, not agent state checkpointing during work.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can give my coding agent a persistent runtime environment that checkpoints its state automatically while working
